text:
jules: quick report  deep links to subsection headings don't jump when the sidebar group is collapsed. Repro: /docs/ops#kv-cache-stale -> no scroll.

tara: confirmed. looks like our hash handler expands the group but doesn't wait for layout before scrolling.

nick: I can put together a tiny fix: on hashchange, if target is in a collapsed group expand synchronously, then queue scroll in a microtask. avoids setTimeout flakiness.

jules: can we also catch duplicates? found one page where mkdocs produced heading and heading-1. caused spurious 404s in linkcheck.

nick: added `scripts/scan-ids.js` to PR that fails CI on duplicate generated ids for main/v2. Leaves a warning only elsewhere.

docsbot: linkcheck: deploy-preview #3898 -> WARN /docs/ops -> #kv-cache-stale (client-side nav failed)

tara: please include a migration note for mkdocs users: "if headings are indented under lists or code fences, prefer explicit {#id}". will save support tickets.

nick: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1586  includes client hash handler, tests for expand+scroll, and id-scan script.

deploy-bot: staging updated: https://deploy-preview-1586--docs.redwood.inference.dev/docs/ops#kv-cache-stale

jules: verified on staging. permalink expands and scrolls. thanks!
